en-US.name: Contract Review Team
en-US.summary: A six-member contract review team: intake gating, clause structuring, parallel risk and jurisdiction checks, independent re-verification, then scored reporting and tracked DOCX delivery
en-US.description: Six members collaborate through stable, observable steps: input coverage, source evidence, real receipts, independent re-verification, and explicit gaps. The Lead creates the case ledger, runs intake and clause facts, fans out jurisdiction and risk checks in parallel, re-reads key claims independently, then produces a scored report and tracked DOCX. Capability debt remains bounded and never becomes a fabricated legal conclusion. A qualified person must review the output before use.

zh-CN.name: 合同审查团队
zh-CN.summary: 六名成员分工的合同审查团队：输入治理、条款结构化、风险与法域并行、独立复核，最后评分并交付带修订 DOCX
zh-CN.description: 六名成员按固定且可观察的步骤协作：文件覆盖、原文证据、真实回执、独立复核和明确欠账。Lead 建立案件账本，执行输入治理与条款事实，再将法域和风险真正并行分发，独立回读重点断言，最后生成评分报告和带修订 DOCX。能力债务保持在受限范围内，不得伪造法律结论；使用前仍需具备资质的人员复核。
